title: Automation gateway for safe batching & caching recommendation application
creator: Maya Chen
description: Implement a hardened automation gateway and SDK primitives to safely apply, monitor, and roll back batching/caching recommendations from Redwood Optimize. This ticket scopes: 1) a REST gateway that mediates recommendation 'apply' operations with idempotency, two-phase preview/commit flows, and rollback support; 2) a webhook handshake and replay-protection model for async apply confirmations; 3) SDK helpers (Node/Python) for clients to call apply/rollback reliably; 4) observability, audit trails, and policy checks for safe automation (RBAC, quotas, conflict detection). Goals: - Prevent double-apply and partially-applied states when retries or duplicates occur. - Ensure every apply is traceable to a recommendation set and can be rolled back deterministically. - Provide clear signals to Console and Optimize reports about cost delta and risk. Out-of-scope: UI work in Console (tracked separately), long-term recommendation reconciliation heuristics (follow-up).
acceptance_criteria: POST /v1/optimize/apply accepts a recommendation bundle and returns a 202 with an idempotency token when valid
Repeated identical requests with same X-Optimize-Idempotency-Key do not create duplicate work (dedupe within 14 days, tombstones stored)
Two-phase flow: preview -> approve -> commit implemented. Preview runs a dry-run and returns deterministic delta and conflict warnings
Rollback endpoint allows deterministic reversal of a committed apply within retention window
SDK exports ApplyClient with apply(), status(), rollback() helpers and automatic retry/backoff on transient errors
Audit entry created for every state transition (preview, commit, rollback) and surfaced to the Console event log
Metrics emitted: optimize.apply_attempts, optimize.apply_success, optimize.apply_duplicates, optimize.apply_rollbacks
Integration tests and e2e test script added to CI; canary rollout gating via feature-flag to 10% of customers
comments: 2025-02-12 Maya Chen: Created ticket after spike. Spike concluded that a gateway with server-side tombstones and a short-term dedupe window is the simplest path for correct-at-most-once semantics without forcing synchronous DB locks across Dedicated clusters.

2025-02-14 Liam Patel: POC server implemented in optimize/gateway. Uses header X-Optimize-Idempotency-Key and stores tombstones in apply-store with 14-day TTL. Initial perf looks fine: 95th latency < 80ms for metadata validation stage.

2025-02-16 Sana Rodriguez (PM): Reviewed design. Ask: include explicit conflict warnings when preview shows model-variant mismatch (customer might have pinned model). Added requirement to fail preview with clear remediation steps rather than auto-mutate.

2025-02-17 Arjun Rao (Security): Security review notes: ensure idempotency token entropy and rotation to avoid replay across tenants; require X-Org-ID + signature header for private deployments. Marked ticket for security gating before canary.

2025-02-18 Code review (GH#1473): reviewers highlighted race between background reconciliation job and commit path. Decided to sequence commits via single-phase DB transaction and publish an ordered commit event to the event stream. Follow-up PR GH#1490 will add optimistic concurrency checks.

2025-02-20 QA: E2E tests failed intermittently on rollback verification for multi-step batching changes. Root cause: earlier implementation didn't snapshot pre-apply KV sizes for partial rollbacks. Fixed with pre-apply state snapshot and deterministic revert logic. Tests now passing locally.

2025-02-22 DevOps: Added feature flag optimize.apply.gateway and a canary rollout plan (10% of orgs for 72h, monitor apply_success and apply_duplicates). Also added a circuit-breaker that opens on >5% failed commits in 10m window.
2025-02-24 Design feedback: Console needs compact toast for preview diffs and a link to the apply trace. Filed UI ticket PM-412 for console integration. Will coordinate rollout after API canary.

2025-02-26 Liam Patel: Preparing release candidate. Migration: backfill tombstones for recent manual applies (migration script in GH#1512). Planning internal runbook for rollback procedures and customer support playbook.
